examples.text: Several students voted against the proposal because it would leave younger children without a safe playground.
examples.translationZh: 幾位學生投票反對提案，因為它會讓年幼孩子失去安全的遊戲場所。
examples.grammar: [S] Several students [V] voted；against the proposal 表立場；because 子句說明原因。
examples.writingTip: 說明反對的具體理由，避免只寫自己不喜歡。

examples.text: After the long hike, Mia leaned against a tree while her friends checked the route home.
examples.translationZh: 長途健行後，Mia 靠著樹，朋友們則查看回家的路線。
examples.grammar: leaned against + N 表接觸支撐，這裡沒有反對的意思。
examples.writingTip: 用動作與空間位置描寫疲憊。

examples.text: Although the library was crowded, its quiet study room allowed me to finish my essay on time.
examples.translationZh: 雖然圖書館很擁擠，安靜的自習室仍讓我準時完成作文。
examples.grammar: Although 引導讓步；[S] its quiet study room [V] allowed [O] me + to V。
examples.writingTip: 以一項不利條件搭配仍達成的結果。

examples.text: The volunteers continued cleaning the beach although the wind made their work much harder than expected.
examples.translationZh: 志工們繼續清理海灘，雖然強風讓工作比預期困難許多。
examples.grammar: 主句在前；although 子句補上逆境，沒有另加 but。
examples.writingTip: 用讓步結構呈現持續努力。

examples.text: Amid growing concern about waste, our school introduced reusable containers at the annual food fair.
examples.translationZh: 在大家愈來愈擔心浪費的情況下，學校在年度園遊會引入可重複使用的容器。
examples.grammar: Amid + N 交代背景；[S] our school [V] introduced [O] reusable containers。
examples.writingTip: 先交代社會背景，再寫具體回應。

examples.text: The teacher remained calm amid the noise and helped the frightened students leave the building safely.
examples.translationZh: 老師在吵鬧聲中保持冷靜，協助受驚學生安全離開建築物。
examples.grammar: amid the noise 是背景片語；remained 後接形容詞 calm。
examples.writingTip: 以環境與人物反應形成對照。

examples.text: The survey revealed growing interest in public transport among students who lived far from the school.
examples.translationZh: 調查顯示，住得離學校較遠的學生對大眾運輸愈來愈有興趣。
examples.grammar: among students 指調查群體；who 子句修飾 students。
examples.writingTip: 界定調查或主張涵蓋的群體。

examples.text: We shared the remaining food among the volunteers so everyone could rest before the final task.
examples.translationZh: 我們把剩下的食物分給志工們，讓每個人能在最後一項任務前休息。
examples.grammar: shared [O] the remaining food；among + 群體表示分配對象。
examples.writingTip: 寫出資源分配的對象與目的。

examples.text: The students collected old books and sold them to raise money for the local animal shelter.
examples.translationZh: 學生收集舊書並出售，替當地動物收容所募款。
examples.grammar: collected 與 sold 共用主詞 students；them 回指 books。
examples.writingTip: 用平行動作交代計畫如何完成。

examples.text: Clean water and reliable electricity are essential when families return home after a severe storm.
examples.translationZh: 家戶在強烈暴風雨後返家時，乾淨的水與穩定供電都很重要。
examples.grammar: [S] Clean water and reliable electricity 是並列主詞，故用 are。
examples.writingTip: 把兩項具體需求並列，檢查動詞單複數。

anyone.usageNote: anyone／anybody 作主詞時用單數動詞；疑問、否定與不限定身分的肯定句皆可用。any one 則強調一個成員。

examples.text: Anyone who wants to join the reading club can attend our first meeting without paying a fee.
examples.translationZh: 任何想加入讀書社的人都能免費參加第一次聚會。
examples.grammar: Anyone 是單數主詞；who wants 修飾它；can attend 後接原形。
examples.writingTip: 讓招募條件清楚，避免漏掉 who 後的單數動詞。

examples.text: I did not know anyone at the workshop, but a friendly partner soon made me feel welcome.
examples.translationZh: 工作坊裡我誰都不認識，但友善的搭檔很快讓我感到受歡迎。
examples.grammar: not ... anyone 表否定範圍；made + O + 原形 feel。
examples.writingTip: 用陌生與被接納的情境描寫轉變。

examples.text: If you notice anything unusual in the experiment, record it carefully before changing the equipment.
examples.translationZh: 如果你在實驗中注意到任何異常，請在調整設備前仔細記錄。
examples.grammar: anything unusual 的形容詞後置；it 回指觀察到的事物。
examples.writingTip: 用具體觀察說明處理步驟。

examples.text: The small museum welcomes anything that helps visitors understand how local families lived a century ago.
examples.translationZh: 這間小博物館歡迎任何能幫助遊客了解百年前當地家庭生活的物品。
examples.grammar: anything 是 welcomes 的受詞；that helps 中 helps 用單數。
examples.writingTip: 用關係子句界定徵集物品的條件。

examples.text: You may contact our group anytime if the instructions for the community project are unclear.
examples.translationZh: 如果社區計畫的說明不清楚，你可以隨時聯絡我們。
examples.grammar: anytime 修飾 contact 的時間；if 子句提出聯絡條件。
examples.writingTip: 在通知中寫清楚何時、為何可以求助。

examples.text: The online guide can be opened anytime, allowing students to review difficult steps at their own pace.
examples.translationZh: 線上指南隨時能開啟，讓學生按照自己的步調複習困難步驟。
examples.grammar: can be opened 是被動；anytime 是副詞，沒有另加 at。
examples.writingTip: 具體說明學習工具提供的便利。

examples.text: We moved the outdoor concert indoors because heavy rain would have made the equipment unsafe.
examples.translationZh: 我們把戶外音樂會移到室內，因為大雨會使設備不安全。
examples.grammar: because 子句說明 moved 的原因；would have made 表原先可能的後果。
examples.writingTip: 把決定與具體原因連接。

examples.text: Because the survey included only one class, its results cannot represent every student in the school.
examples.translationZh: 因為調查只涵蓋一個班級，結果無法代表全校每位學生。
examples.grammar: because 子句在前以逗號分開；only 限制資料範圍。
examples.writingTip: 用因果句說明證據的限制。

examples.text: I sat beside the new student and explained the activity before the teacher divided us into groups.
examples.translationZh: 我坐在新同學旁邊，在老師分組前向他說明活動。

examples.text: The school sent parents a notice concerning changes to the bus route during the road repairs.
examples.translationZh: 學校寄給家長一份通知，說明道路施工期間公車路線的變動。

examples.text: Students raised questions concerning privacy after the new app requested access to their personal photographs.
examples.translationZh: 新應用程式要求存取私人照片後，學生提出了隱私方面的問題。
examples.grammar: questions concerning privacy 是名詞片語；after 子句交代觸發事件。
examples.writingTip: 以具體事件引出討論議題。

examples.text: Unused cosmetics were kept in a separate box so the volunteers could sort the donated items safely.

examples.text: The first proposal focused on lowering costs, whereas the second gave greater priority to long-term environmental benefits.

examples.text: The report raised questions about whether the survey included enough students to support its broad conclusion.
